question: In which Asian Games did India first win a gold medal in athletics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1951**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The **first Asian Games** were held in **1951** in **New Delhi, India**. These games marked the beginning of India's participation in the continental multi-sport event.

• **India's first gold medal in athletics** was won during these games. It was an important milestone for the country in international sports.

• The gold medal was secured by **Sohan Singh Dhanoa** in the **men's 1500 meters race**, earning him a place in history as the first Indian to win a gold medal in athletics at the Asian Games.
